title: Voice Mimic System revised demo video
author: Beautiful_Sky_790
selftext:
I've developed a process to combine an actor's actual performance with AI voice technology. More than voice cloning, it maintains their performance while allowing deep personalization within it.

This is a revised video with a new comparison section, a visual description of how the process works, and punchier examples.

Looking for any thoughts and feedback. Thanks.

comments.author: ELPascalito
comments.body: Not trying to be negative, but both the TTS examples are very low quality, are you running the model in real-time? But the idea is nice, could add a layer of personalisation!

replies.author: Beautiful_Sky_790
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback! Which lines are you referring to? Every line in the video is TTS. The last two? How is it low quality? Do you mean the line reading or the audio fidelity? Yes, it runs in real-time. Thanks!

replies.author: ELPascalito
replies.body: Okay running in real time explains the fidelity, we are so used to Eleven labs and other strong models that the local ones seem too artificial, but seeing as it's running real time I think speed is key, I presume it's Kokoro? Anyhow the secret is spacing, weaker models just output all the words with no sense of pace, adding small paused even if exaggerated or on purpose, might space out dialogue, and make it not seem robotic, but again it's realtime so I don't think we have any margin to complain, best of luck!

comments.author: surpurdurd
comments.body: Neat! Do you plan on releasing this as an unreal engine plugin at some point, or is the process too complicated for that? Any plans for supporting other engines?

replies.author: Beautiful_Sky_790
replies.body: I don't know any Unreal. This is in Unity. The real work is in customizing the system for each game. I envision it as something we would collaborate with other companies with to build it into their games.
